About me

I'm Timilehin Onileowo, a graphics designer and social media manager, and the creative director at The Nerd's Designs. People know me as The Multi Talented Nerd.

I design logos, flyers, posters and branding, and I manage social media pages so that businesses, student unions and events look sharp and get noticed. I also teach smartphone graphic design through free courses for beginners.
